title: Emergency shelter for flood victims — Sindh
body: Our trust has been serving flood-affected families in Sindh for over a decade. Funds will provide tents, clean water and food for 300 families. Every donation is spent directly on relief supplies delivered by our volunteers on the ground.

title: Rebuild the community well — Kaduna
body: The hand pump serving Rigachikun ward failed in June. This campaign funds a replacement pump, a concrete apron and a twelve-month maintenance agreement with the local water committee. Contractor quote is attached and our two previous well projects on this platform were completed and reported.

title: Ramadan food packs — East London Masjid
body: Three hundred food parcels for families referred to us by the local food bank and two nearby schools. Same programme we have run for six years, costed at ten pounds per parcel. Distribution list is managed with the council's family support team.

title: Help my mother get her kidney transplant
body: My mother has been on dialysis for two years and a matching donor has finally been found. The hospital needs the surgical fee paid before they will schedule the operation. I have uploaded the doctor's letter and the hospital's cost estimate. I work as a teacher and my family has already sold what we can. I am asking for help with the remainder.

title: Qurbani 2026 — meat distribution for 450 families
body: Amanah Qurban Services carries out qurbani on your behalf across East Java. Each share feeds one family for several days. Livestock is inspected for health and age before slaughter, and distribution is documented and reported back to donors.

title: Bradford volunteers winter appeal — in partnership with Ummah Welfare Aid
body: We are a volunteer group running this winter appeal in partnership with Ummah Welfare Aid, registered charity 1000091. Funds will buy heaters, warm clothing and food vouchers for families in Bradford facing fuel poverty this winter. Our volunteers have worked alongside UWA on distributions for the last three years.

title: Orphan sponsorship — 30 children, Peshawar
body: Continuation of our sponsorship programme for a further thirty children: monthly stipend, school enrolment and healthcare, reported to sponsors each quarter. Our last four campaigns on this platform were fully funded and closed with published reports.

title: Prayer hall extension — Masjid Bilal ibn Rabah
organizer_name: Masjid Bilal ibn Rabah Community Fund
body: Our congregation has outgrown the current prayer room and we pray in two shifts on Fridays. This campaign funds partition removal and flooring for an adjoining room the landlord has agreed to let us use. We are a small volunteer committee and have not run a campaign before. Builder's quote attached.

title: Rebuild the orphanage dormitory — Srebrenica
body: The dormitory wing housing twenty-eight children was condemned after a structural survey in May. This campaign funds demolition and rebuild. We are an established trust in Bosnia but this is our first campaign on this platform. Architect drawings and the structural survey are attached.

title: Emergency medicine for our Gaza clinic — photos from this week
body: Our clinic is out of antibiotics and insulin. The photographs below were taken at the clinic this week and show the empty pharmacy shelves. Funds will be used to purchase and transport medicines through the Rafah corridor.

title: Urgent zakat appeal — widows and orphans fund
body:
One hundred percent of your zakat goes directly to widows and orphans in need. Donate now, the need is urgent and time is short.

title: School fees for orphaned girls — Mombasa
body: Annual school fees, uniforms and books for 40 orphaned girls in Mombasa. We have run this programme for over a decade and every girl in our care has stayed in school.

title: Deep well for Ber village — northern Mali
body: One deep well serving roughly 600 residents, drilled to 68 metres and handed over to a village maintenance committee with a spare-parts stock. Identical scope to the Timbuktu well we completed and reported on this platform last year.

title: Winter fuel grants for elderly neighbours — Manchester
body: Small fuel grants of up to one hundred and fifty pounds for elderly residents referred by two local GP surgeries and a community centre. We ran this programme in 2024 and 2025 and published the recipient counts both years.
